newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS raises trend on Fairfax to positive.
newsitem.headline: DBRS raises trend on Fairfax to positive.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service Ltd said on Wednesday that it had confirmed a BBB (high) rating on long-term debt for Fairfax Financial Holdings Ltd and upgraded the trend from stable to positive.

"The positive trend recognizes the possibility of a future rating upgrade given the progress which Fairfax continues to make in growing and diversifying its base of businesses, while maintaining acceptable capital and generally favorable profitability ratios," DBRS said.
Last year, Fairfax acquired the Odyssey Reinsurance Company and contracted for the acquisition of CTR (Paris) in a bid to expand internationally.
"These two acquisitions significantly add to Fairfax's re-insurance participation in global markets," DBRS said.
